purpose: Tested OpenDocument/open-format compatibility matrix for Archiv ingestion, retrieval, citation, and output (issue #37). Every family claim is re-verified by tests/test_format_matrix.py against live local ingestion runs; unsupported formats are rejected explicitly, never silently accepted.

families.detection: suffix plus bounded UTF-8 decoding; undecodable content fails closed
families.preview_render: the preserved bytes are the truth; any text viewer can show them
families.encryption: no encryption layer exists; bytes are preserved verbatim
known_limits: line locators only; no paragraph or section semantics

families.detection: suffix plus PDF structure parsing via pypdf; malformed files fail closed
families.preview_render: LibreOffice render for report validation; poppler pdftoppm only for bounded OCR rendering of textless pages
families.macros: embedded scripts and actions are never executed
families.encryption: undecryptable inputs fail closed during normalization; no password handling is attempted
known_limits: text follows content-stream order, not visual layout

pages without native text yield conditional visual_ocr segments only when local Tesseract and Poppler tools are present (page, line, and pixel-region locators); with tools absent ingestion stays valid with no searchable text

families.detection: suffix plus OOXML package validation via python-docx; renamed or corrupt packages fail closed
families.preview_render: LibreOffice render inside the verified report workflow
families.macros: macros and active content are never executed
families.encryption: encrypted packages fail closed during normalization; no password handling is attempted
known_limits: comments, tracked changes, and header/footer decorations are not separately surfaced as text segments

families.detection: suffix plus FIB (File Information Block) validation of the WordDocument stream; malformed or unsupported FIB versions fail closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; search and citations address extracted text segments
families.macros: only the WordDocument and table (0Table/1Table) streams are ever opened; a VBA project storage is never read
families.encryption: documents with the FIB fEncrypted flag set fail closed during normalization; no password handling is attempted
known_limits: character formatting, styles, fields, comments, tracked changes, and embedded objects are not extracted
table cell structure is not reconstructed; cell text is emitted as plain paragraph text

families.detection: suffix plus the {\rtf1 control-word magic; missing or malformed control structure fails closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; search and citations address extracted text segments
families.macros: this is a bounded plain-text control-word walk; embedded \pict and \object/\objdata payloads are skipped as opaque data and never decoded or activated
families.encryption: RTF has no native encryption concept; nothing is decrypted or password-handled
known_limits: font/colour/style tables, document info, headers/footers, footnotes, field codes, and index/TOC entries are treated as non-body and dropped
character formatting, tables, and embedded objects are not reconstructed
a \uN Unicode escape's replacement run is only correctly skipped when it is a plain character or \'hh escape, not a nested control word

families.detection: suffix plus OOXML package validation via openpyxl; renamed or corrupt packages fail closed
families.preview_render: LibreOffice render inside the verified report workflow
families.macros: formulas are surfaced as text only and never executed
families.encryption: encrypted packages fail closed during normalization; no password handling is attempted
known_limits: formatting, charts, and pivot state are not reconstructed
retrieval indexes each normalized cell or row segment independently; phrases split across cells may not match as one literal phrase

families.detection: suffix plus BIFF8 structure validation via xlrd; malformed workbooks fail closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; search and citations address extracted cell text
families.macros: xlrd parses the BIFF record stream directly and never opens a VBA project storage; macros are never executed
families.encryption: RC4/XOR-obfuscated workbooks fail closed during normalization (xlrd rejects the FILEPASS record); no password handling is attempted
known_limits: formula source text is not decompiled from BIFF tokens; only the last calculated (cached) value is extracted
formatting, charts, and pivot state are not reconstructed
retrieval indexes each normalized cell independently; phrases split across cells may not match as one literal phrase

families.encryption: encrypted packages fail closed during normalization; no password handling is attempted
known_limits: speaker notes timing and animation semantics are not surfaced

families.detection: suffix plus bounded record-tree validation of the PowerPoint Document stream; malformed or truncated records fail closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; search and citations address extracted text segments
families.macros: only the PowerPoint Document stream is ever opened; a VBA project storage is never read

families.detection: suffix plus validated ZIP mimetype and database content root; unexpected structure fails closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; object names are the inspectable surface

families.detection: suffix plus native InPage100/InPage300 stream identification inside a bounded CFB container; suffix spoofing and unknown variants fail closed
families.preview_render: no rendering; search and citations address extracted text segments
families.macros: no embedded execution surface is invoked; the CFB container is parsed as data only
families.encryption: not applicable to supported variants; unparseable variants fail closed
known_limits: native searchable-text ingestion only; text_fidelity is searchable_best_effort
page geometry, frames, stories, columns, styles, and pixel-identical layout are explicitly not reconstructed (tracked separately)

families.detection: suffix plus image decode validation via Pillow; corrupt images fail closed
families.preview_render: the preserved image is the truth; OCR attests page/line/pixel-region coordinates when run

OCR output is derived evidence with provenance and never overwrites the original

families.detection: XML header and SVG root element parsing; malformed XML, DTD entity expansion, or external references fail closed
families.preview_render: sandboxed resvg rendering when available; text elements extracted natively without external rendering
families.macros: script elements and external resources are ignored and never executed
known_limits: complex path-rendered text requires optional deep-tier OCR rendering

families.detection: suffix plus RIFF/WAVE header parsing; corrupt audio fails closed
families.preview_render: no transcription in this version; playback happens outside Archiv
known_limits: audio transcription is deferred until a bounded local processor with evidence-backed acceptance tests exists
metadata (channels, sample rate, duration) is recorded for provenance

field_trial_decision.method: Rank only observed or explicitly confirmed gaps; do not add parsers without lawful fixtures and measurable user-work evidence.

ranked_next_work.reason: The real-world corpus contained rejected .doc files. A bounded native FIB/Clx parser (no sandboxed converter) is implemented and verified against lawful synthetic fixtures; real-world-corpus user-question impact has not yet been separately measured.

The real-world corpus contained rejected .rtf files. A bounded control-word plain-text parser (no sandboxed converter) is implemented and verified against lawful synthetic fixtures; real-world-corpus user-question impact has not yet been separately measured.
Field notes confirmed cross-cell phrase misses; benchmark row-aware retrieval before changing normalized-output or locator contracts.
